verdict.rationale: Foreloop orchestrates tasks and lets an agent (Claude Code/Codex) claim a task, do the work, and open a PR in the user's repo, which covers end-to-end feature implementation via an external coding agent — but Foreloop itself doesn't write code or tests; it delegates that entirely to the connected agent, and there's no explicit mention of test-writing behavior or verification. missing for 10: explicit evidence that generated PRs include tests, independent/hands-on confirmation of successful end-to-end feature delivery, and detail on how test coverage is verified before approval.
